# *Hi there, I’m Naaz! 👋*

I'm a marketing professional transitioning into the world of data and AI. My background started in communications and marketing, where I learned to think about people, stories, and business problems. After about three years on the creative side of marketing, I realized that strong marketing strategies need more than good ideas. They need data to understand what works, why it works, and who it works for. 

My goal is to explore how data, creativity and storytelling can come together to drive impactful strategies. Connect with me and follow along as I build projects, explore ideas, and turn data into meaningful insights and strategies!

[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/naaz-parvaz/){.btn .btn-primary}  [Resume](naaz_resume.pdf){.btn .btn-primary}  [GitHub](https://github.com/naazparvaz){.btn .btn-primary}

## CURRENTLY

I'm currently pursuing an **MS in AI & Business Analytics from Zicklin School of Business at Baruch College**, where I'm building my technical skills to unlock the power of data in marketing.

**I'm taking 4 classes this semester!**

1. Principles of Database Management
2. Basic Software Tools for Data Analysis
3. Programming for Analytics
4. Business Communication

**Key technical skills I'm building:**

* R
* SQL
* Python
* Statistics
* Effective Communication
